# KuroCat Skin Workshop & Community Plaza (workshop.kurocat.cc)

> Official free browser-based 2.5D cat skin editor, accessory studio, and community plaza for KuroCat (`https://kurocat.cc/`), the native open-source desktop cat pet for macOS, Windows, Linux, and UOS.

## Official Links
- [KuroCat Skin Workshop & Plaza](https://workshop.kurocat.cc/)
- [KuroCat Official Homepage (Chinese)](https://kurocat.cc/)
- [KuroCat Official Homepage (English)](https://kurocat.cc/en/)
- [OBS & Streaming Setup Guide](https://kurocat.cc/obs-guide/)
- [Full Technical Reference (`llms-full.txt`)](https://kurocat.cc/llms-full.txt)
- [KuroCat Source Repository](https://github.com/chanke17/KuroCat)
- [Workshop Repository & Community PRs](https://github.com/chanke17/KuroCat-Workshop)

## Featured Free Community Skins (`.kurocat`)
- **小豆泥（彩蛋限定 / Xiao Douni）**: Comic-style special renderer with hand-drawn wired keyboard, impact sparks, mochi-flatten petting, and ice-blue lifted eyes.
- **怪猎呆猫（艾露猫 / Monster Hunter Dazed Cat Palico）**: Native `renderStyle: "dazed"` renderer with indigo hood, flared cuffs, wide black-rimmed eyes, and back greatsword.
- **狸花猫（中华田园虎斑 / Chinese Li Hua Tabby）**, **棕虎斑（暖棕鲭鱼纹 / Brown Mackerel Tabby）**, **埃及农民（阿比西尼亚 / Abyssinian）**, **皇家墨镜奶牛猫（Royal Tuxedo）**, **胖橘白（Chubby Orange & White）**, **软萌三花猫（Soft Calico）**, **海双布偶猫（Seal Ragdoll）**, **圆脸英短蓝猫（British Blue）**.

## Featured Free Accessories & Mechanical Keyboards (`.kurokb`)
- **Accessories**: 招财小鱼发卡, 8-bit 像素大佬墨镜, 魔法小尖帽, 抹茶奶油小领结.
- **65% Keyboards**: 小豆泥复古灰键 (`douni-retro`), 樱花奶盖 65% (`sakura-milk`), 抹茶拿铁 65% (`matcha-latte`), 赛博电青 65% (`cyber-vapor`), 复古掌机 DMG (`gameboy-retro`).

## How to Install Any Skin or Keyboard
- Drag and drop any `.kurocat` or `.kurokb` file directly onto your running KuroCat desktop pet window on macOS, Windows, or Linux to apply immediately.
